frame_pacing.scope: Render-thread elapsed observations exclude outer 1ms sleep/startup; inverse mean is not actual FPS. Percentiles are histogram upper bounds. dropped_frames means abandoned in-progress observations at lifecycle/generation boundaries, not compositor drops. Stage render_submit includes host/driver elapsed work, not GPU duration; zero-sample stages are unknown. No per-second minimum or full-game performance claim.
